title: UI Framework Module
summary: This module provides a flexible framework for integrating Pydantic AI agents with various user interfaces, handling request/response adaptation, event streaming, and message sanitization for different UI protocols like AG-UI and Vercel AI.

nodes.label: Frontend Request
nodes.title: User/Client Input
nodes.description: Incoming HTTP requests from a UI client, containing chat messages, tool calls, and other interaction data.

nodes.label: UI Adapter (Base)
nodes.title: Abstract UI Protocol Adapter
nodes.description: Base class for adapting UI-specific request formats into Pydantic AI agent inputs and transforming agent outputs back into UI-specific event streams. Handles message sanitization and system prompt management.

nodes.label: AG-UI Adapter
nodes.title: AG-UI Protocol Adapter
nodes.description: Concrete implementation of UIAdapter for the AG-UI protocol. Manages AG-UI specific run inputs and integrates AG-UI frontend tools.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Adapter
nodes.title: Vercel AI Protocol Adapter
nodes.description: Concrete implementation of UIAdapter for the Vercel AI protocol. Handles Vercel AI specific message formats, tool approval workflows, and event streaming.

nodes.label: Pydantic AI Agent
nodes.title: Agent Execution Core
nodes.description: The core Pydantic AI agent responsible for processing messages, executing tools, and generating responses based on its configured model and capabilities.

nodes.label: UI Event Stream
nodes.title: Protocol Event Transformer
nodes.description: Abstract base class for transforming Pydantic AI's native event stream into a UI-specific event stream, handling event encoding and dispatching.

nodes.label: Frontend Response
nodes.title: Streamed UI Output
nodes.description: Outgoing HTTP responses streamed back to the UI client, containing protocol-specific events like text, tool calls, and status updates.

nodes.label: Run AG-UI Endpoint
nodes.title: AG-UI Chat Endpoint
nodes.description: Entry point for running an agent with AG-UI specific inputs and streaming events back to the AG-UI frontend.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Chat Endpoint
nodes.title: Vercel AI Chat Endpoint
nodes.description: Entry point for handling chat requests conforming to the Vercel AI protocol, using the VercelAIAdapter.

nodes.label: Configure Frontend Endpoint
nodes.title: UI Configuration Endpoint
nodes.description: Provides metadata about available models and built-in tools to the frontend for dynamic UI configuration.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Request Types
nodes.title: Vercel AI Input Structures
nodes.description: Pydantic models defining the structure of incoming request data for the Vercel AI protocol, including various UI parts for text, files, and tool interactions.

nodes.label: Vercel AI Response Types
nodes.title: Vercel AI Output Structures
nodes.description: Pydantic models defining the structure of outgoing streamed data chunks for the Vercel AI protocol, such as source URLs, documents, and data.

nodes.label: AG-UI Toolset
nodes.title: AG-UI Frontend Tool Definitions
nodes.description: A specialized toolset that encapsulates definitions for tools exposed by the AG-UI frontend, allowing the agent to interact with UI-specific functionalities.

nodes.label: Pydantic AI Messages
nodes.title: Internal Message Format
nodes.description: Standardized internal message representations (e.g., ModelRequest, ModelResponse, SystemPromptPart) used by the Pydantic AI agent core.

nodes.label: Pydantic AI Native Events
nodes.title: Internal Event Stream
nodes.description: Raw, low-level events generated by the Pydantic AI agent during its execution, such as part starts, deltas, ends, and tool call/result events.

groups.label: Surface Endpoints
groups.title: API Endpoints for UI Interaction
groups.description: These components expose the functionality of the UI framework as HTTP endpoints for client applications.

groups.label: Protocol Adapters
groups.title: UI Protocol Adaptation Layer
groups.description: Components responsible for translating between generic Pydantic AI agent interactions and specific UI protocol formats.

groups.label: Event Processing
groups.title: Agent Event Transformation
groups.description: Handles the transformation and encoding of internal agent events into a format suitable for streaming to UI clients.

groups.label: Data Structures
groups.title: UI-Specific Data Formats
groups.description: Defines the data models used for communication with specific UI frontends and internal message/event representations.
